svg.title: Black with White Triangle
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. The Foundation’s 1973 MoMA installation photograph explicitly labels EK501; matches the 1996 Guggenheim studio photograph. White inverted triangle joins rotated black rectangle. Dimensions unknown; observed proportions normalized.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-4/; record guggenheim1996-essay-37-fig-34b; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
